name: bruckner
title: Bruckner et al. 2026: results reporting of EU Phase II-IV trials in CTIS
description: Two or three reviewers read each due trial's CTIS summary of results and answered three questions: does it report how many participants took part, does it give a result for every primary endpoint, and does it say nobody was enrolled. The expected label is 'full' when their final assessment of the scientific results document was full.
citation: Bruckner T, Dike CE, Caquelin L, Freeman A, Aspromonti DA, DeVito NJ, Song Z, Karam G, Nilsonne G. Assessing Compliance with Reporting Requirements in European Phase II-IV Clinical Trials: A Cross-Sectional Observational Study. medRxiv preprint, 2026. doi:10.64898/2026.04.03.26350111

evidence.description: The summary of results posted in CTIS before the export of 2025-11-10. A trial whose results were submitted again later may now have documents the reviewers never read.
